lines.zh: 我走过的地方，土塌了一点。
lines.en: Where I pass, some dirt has fallen in.
I don't chase; I only walk over.

lines.zh: 每一步都踩在你的运气上。
lines.en: Every step lands on your luck.

lines.zh: 我从走廊那头过来，很慢。
lines.en: I come down the corridor, slowly.

lines.zh: 我碰到的东西开始坏了。
lines.en: Whatever I touch starts to spoil.

lines.zh: 门轴在我身后自己转了。
lines.en: The hinge turned by itself behind me.

lines.zh: 我不着急，坏事会自己发生。
lines.en: I'm in no hurry; misfortune happens on its own.

lines.zh: 我沿着墙面走，掉了些灰。
lines.en: I move along the wall, shedding dust.
Your torch is smoking black.

lines.zh: 我靠近什么，什么就出问题。
lines.en: Whatever I approach starts to go wrong.

lines.zh: 我走一步，你脚下的木板响一声。
lines.en: Each step of mine makes your floorboard groan.
I stop not far behind you.

lines.zh: 我站在那儿，什么也不做。
lines.en: I stand there and do nothing.
Things simply go bad.

lines.zh: 你刚才那一下差点摔倒吧。
lines.en: You nearly fell just now, didn't you?
I didn't touch anything.
The plaster peels behind me.
I count the bad luck on you.
This room has started to seep.

lines.zh: 安静的时候最容易出事。
lines.en: Things go wrong most easily when it's quiet.

lines.zh: 我抬了抬手，灰尘就落下来。
lines.en: I lift a hand, and dust falls.
Your blade is coming loose.
The wick is burning fast.
I don't need to lift a finger.

lines.zh: 这块石头本来不在这儿。
lines.en: This stone wasn't here before.
I stand and wait.

lines.zh: 你身上已经有点不对了。
lines.en: Something about you has already gone wrong.
There is a grey thread behind you.
Don't look at me; look at your feet.
I'm close to you, and you're fine so far.

lines.zh: 我一靠近，你的运气就掉。
lines.en: The closer I come, the more your luck runs out.

lines.zh: 你手上那道口子不是划的。
lines.en: That cut on your hand didn't come from a blade.
I've looked up; you'd better move.
Do you want to try touching me?
Your torch is dripping.
After I leave, things get worse.
If you run, your soles will slip.

lines.zh: 你贴得太近，我只好伤你。
lines.en: Too close, so I have to hurt you.
Your wound is hot.

lines.zh: 等一下，你身后那块石头要掉。
lines.en: Wait — that stone behind you is about to fall.
Listen, the roof is creaking.

lines.zh: 我已经碰到你的影子了。
lines.en: I've already touched your shadow.
There's a small hole in your waterskin.
Making you trip is the least of it.

lines.zh: 你的东西一件件开始坏。
lines.en: Your things are failing one by one.
Staying away from me is better for you.
You struck me; your hand will swell.
I've withdrawn, and you're still standing.
A small flake of me falls like ash.
I didn't strike back.
Did you hear that crack?
I lurched once and steadied.

lines.zh: 你会为此付出一点代价。
lines.en: You'll pay a small price for that.

lines.zh: 我脚下的裂缝合上了一半。
lines.en: Half the crack beneath me has closed.
I'm waiting for you to regret it.
The wound isn't on me.

lines.zh: 你拿来的东西，已经旧了一半。
lines.en: Half of what you brought is already worn.
I don't eat; I only spoil it.
Don't shake your hand, or you'll spill.
One touch from me and it molds.
That would have kept a long time.
Set it down and let me look.

lines.zh: 你一转身，它就掉地上了。
lines.en: Turn around, and it lands on the floor.
I advise you not to take anything else out.
It's gone soft in my hand.
I've taken half the luck from it.

lines.zh: 碰了我一下，你脚踝扭了。
lines.en: You touched me, and your ankle twisted.
That wasn't me striking.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，你听见裂声了吗？
lines.en: We collided — did you hear the crack?
Your hand is going numb.

lines.zh: 我退开了，你还站在原地。
lines.en: I've stepped back, and you're still standing there.

lines.zh: 你碰过的地方会一直疼。
lines.en: Where you touched me will keep hurting.
That cloth on you has torn.
Don't steady yourself on me.
I only brushed your cuff.
You've already taken it.

lines.zh: 我不适合靠近任何活物。
lines.en: I'm not fit to be near anything living.
Nor is the other one.

lines.zh: 我们站着，中间隔着一道裂缝。
lines.en: We stand with a crack between us.
The water on the floor runs both ways.

lines.zh: 你看着我，我却不动一下。
lines.en: You stare; I don't move a hair.

lines.zh: 我靠近她，她的东西开始坏。
lines.en: I come near her, and her things start to spoil.

lines.zh: 她连脚下的地也弄坏了。
lines.en: She ruins the ground underfoot too.
This counts as walking together, for us.
Misfortune breeds on its own.
We don't need to touch.

lines.zh: 我拿起来的时候它裂了。
lines.en: It cracked when I picked it up.
This is no use now.

lines.zh: 我把它放进你的背包底层。
lines.en: I put it at the bottom of your pack.
It turns black in my hand.
One touch of my hand and it breaks.
You'd better not ask for it back.
It shattered when it dropped.
I crush it; it was light.
The floor is covered in debris.
I'm not carrying anything.
Standing right there is enough.
Don't run; you won't get far.
The closer I come, the colder you get.
The ground under you is groaning.

lines.zh: 我锁住你了，虽然我没打算动手。
lines.en: I've locked onto you, though I don't mean to strike.

lines.zh: 你的护甲已经有裂缝了。
lines.en: Your armor already has a crack.
My approach alone is enough.
Your weapon is dulling.
Three steps between us.
When I take this step, you'll fall.
Collision is enough — no aiming needed.
You're already unlucky.
One touch and you keep losing health.
The air behind you grows heavy.
This blow isn't against you.
It's against the ground at your feet.
I keep following you.
The faster you go, the worse it gets.
I make no sound; my presence is enough.
Your soles are starting to come apart.

lines.zh: 你再快一点，会撞上门框。
lines.en: A little faster and you'll hit the doorframe.
I take one step forward.
The stone behind you is loose.
I raise my hand and do nothing.
You're panting, and it's getting worse.
Your lamp is about to go out.
I move slowly along the wall.

lines.zh: 你每退一步，地上就多一道裂。
lines.en: Every step you retreat, another crack opens.
Your hands are shaking; don't grip so hard.
I don't need to chase.
Your strength will run out on its own.

lines.zh: 碰到我，你就没停过流血。
lines.en: Touch me and the bleeding won't stop.
That plank won't hold you.
I'm right here, watching.
Your bad luck has already begun.

lines.zh: 我的指节抵住你的锁骨。
lines.en: My knuckles press against your collarbone.

lines.zh: 我的指尖让你皮肤发白。
lines.en: My fingertip pales your skin.
Your hand opened and it fell.
Your own feet tripped you.
That one drew no blood.
Everything on you starts to rattle.

lines.zh: 我按住你的肩，你退不了。
lines.en: I press your shoulder and you can't retreat.
You can smell the mold now, can't you?
I didn't throw a punch.
You're down and can't get up.
I've crouched down beside you.
Your wound is rotting.
None of this was my doing.
I'm only standing here.
Listen, your armor is splitting.
I've taken one step back.
This touch is heavier than it looks.
The air here has grown heavy.
I stand in the doorway without coming in.
A crack has opened under your feet.
The picture on the wall has gone crooked.
The lamp has begun to flicker.

lines.zh: 我不需要出现，我只是在。
lines.en: I needn't appear; I'm simply here.
Dust falls from above.

lines.zh: 你的运气从这一刻开始变差。
lines.en: Your luck turns from this moment.
I lift my foot and set it down.
The lamp in the room dims a notch.
I haven't come to kill you.
Just passing by — don't mind me.
The iron on you is rusting.
Water seeps from the ceiling.
No one called me.
The grass dies where I stand.
I lower my hands.
Tonight will be hard.

lines.zh: 碰一下，痛就一直跟着你。
lines.en: One touch and the pain follows you.
Anyone who touches me rots.

lines.zh: 火烧过的地方寸草不生，我也不喜欢。
lines.en: Nothing grows where fire has passed, and I dislike it too.

lines.zh: 我掉下来，周围的石头跟着裂。
lines.en: I fall, and the stones around me crack.
Water fills me and I start to leak.

lines.zh: 炸开的东西散了一地，很脏。
lines.en: The blast scatters everything, and it's filthy.

lines.zh: 箭插进我身上，周围的铁开始锈。
lines.en: The arrow lodges in me and nearby iron rusts.

lines.zh: 那股力让我短暂地不能靠近。
lines.en: That force briefly keeps me from drawing close.

lines.zh: 我从不进食，饿是给别人准备的。
lines.en: I never eat; hunger is for others.

lines.zh: 雷打在近处，屋顶塌了一角。
lines.en: Lightning strikes nearby and a corner of the roof falls in.

lines.zh: 脚下什么都没有，我一路下坠。
lines.en: There's nothing underfoot and I fall all the way down.
